title: Learn 배고파 (“I’m hungry”) by singing it 🎵 #learnkorean
caption:
Learn 배고파 (bae-go-pa) the catchy way — it means “I’m hungry”.
Casual Korean for friends and family. Polite form: 배고파요 (bae-go-pa-yo).
Sing along, then give it a go yourself!
